name: ensoniqplaywav
description: ensoniqplay(1) M3 WAV parse: an 8-bit unsigned WAV (RIFF/WAVE, 22050 Hz mono, 0.5 s) is played placed.  Proves the WAV header parser reads bits/channels/rate and that 8-bit WAV is treated as unsigned.  Same DOC outcome as the raw 8-bit test (11025 samples, ~30 ticks) but reached through the header path.
